title: Yummy Creamy Portuguese Chicken Soup
description: A comforting Portuguese-style chicken soup that is creamy, soothing, and perfect for sick days. It uses chicken bouillon powder for depth and toasted bread for crunch.
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and set aside.
In a medium pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the smoked paprika and let it bloom for 30 seconds.
Pour in the water and sprinkle the chicken bouillon powder, stirring to dissolve.
Add the bay leaf and bring the mixture to a simmer; then add the chicken cubes and cook until the chicken is cooked through (about 10-12 minutes).
While the chicken cooks, whisk the milk and heavy cream together, then stir them into the soup to create a creamy texture.
Remove the bay leaf, season with salt and pepper to taste, and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Finish by adding the chopped parsley and lemon juice, stirring well.
Serve the soup hot, topped with toasted bread cubes for crunch.
